**Nvidia Dismisses 'Bring Jensen Back' Campaign As Trump Backs Effort**
According to BBC Business, Nvidia has dismissed a 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign, while a number of tech figures and Trump have backed an effort asking the AI chip giant to reinstate its ex CEO, Jensen Huang. Evidence is based solely on the RSS description; the full article was not fetched. This is a single source and not an independent confirmation.
